reviewer_decision: true positive: unauthenticated toolbox proxy sends stored Jira credentials to a caller-chosen host (CWE-522, CWE-918)
reviewer_notes: agento/modules/jira/toolbox/jira-proxy.js: host = req.body.jira_host || config.host while user/token fall back to the configured global Jira credentials (getJiraConfig(null)); fetch(`${host}${path}`) sends Authorization: Basic user:token to that host and returns the body. POST /api/jira/request is registered on the toolbox Express app, which authenticates no caller (server.js: "the internal Docker network IS its boundary") and listens on 0.0.0.0:3001; the agent sandbox container shares agento-net (docker-compose template), so a prompt-injected agent can exfiltrate the tool credential the README says the sandbox never holds. Affected 0.6.0 through 0.16.3 (latest stable, 2026-09-29). Fixed in pre-release 0.17.0rc2 (host no longer overridable, path must be host-relative).
